title: 朝阳隼外胎使用感受
notes: Owner post (2025-09-11): Falcon tires in black, yellow and pink: good puncture resistance and durability (about 100 km of potholes and gravel without damage), about 280 g with coloured versions about 30 g heavier, average rolling, a firm ride, some wobble on coloured tires and slight cracking over time. Commenters: one new tire leaked through about a dozen holes along the sidewall edge after 40 km; a commuter tire was fine at nearly 5,000 km.
